name: claude-receipts
description: Claude Code mods that make your agent show receipts: evidence-gated completion claims and crash-safe session rescue.

plugins.name: test-truth-gate
plugins.description: Records every test, API check and render result, marks it stale when files change, and refuses a success claim the evidence does not hold

plugins.name: session-rescue
plugins.description: Crash-safe, redacted checkpoints of a session's work; offers unfinished or unverified work to the next session in the folder and never reruns a destructive step without approval.
